snippet.title: Five Nights at PP World Official: Remastered | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
It's almost here. 

Five Nights at PP World Official: Remastered is the remastered version of the first FNAPPWO game. 
Everything that is included in this game:
- All five nights, plus an extra sixth
- An extras menu, with all character renders + custom night
- Brand new phone calls, and cutscenes
- 16:9 window on a new Clickteam build
- Extra folders of art + cutscenes

About FNAPPWO:
Welcome to the PP World Dungeon, a place where everyone is treated like PP. You play as Oz (nicknamed Globey) who has an important job to do, as he is the night watchman. There are six teenage zombies back from the dead, haunting the place at night. You must use the cameras, doors and lights to track their locations and prevent them from entering in your office. You must survive all five nights. 

Developed by Elemental Studios, Five Nights at PP World Official: Remastered releases April 4th 2026.
